title: セイバールート四日目-11

pages.ja:
縁側に腰をかけて、ぼんやりと青空を見上げる。
昼間っから眠ってしまったセイバーではないが、こっちも休憩が必要だった。

pages.en:
I sit on the veranda, gazing absently up at the blue sky.

I may not have fallen asleep in broad daylight like Saber, but I need a break too.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I sit on the porch and look up at the blue sky absent-mindedly.
I’m not like Saber who went to bed already during the day, but I need rest too.

pages.ja:
……吐き気は治まったものの、体の具合は依然最悪。
おまけに、次から次へと予期せぬ展開を押しつけられて両肩がぐっと重い。

pages.en:
…The nausea has subsided, but I still feel terrible.

And as if that weren't enough, one unforeseen development after another has been dumped on me, until both shoulders feel leaden.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Even though my nausea has gone away, I still feel terrible.
And on top of that, my shoulders are heavy from all the unexpected developments.

pages.en:
“——Hah.”

I take a deep breath and stare blankly out at the garden.

For now, I've asked everything I needed to ask. That doesn't change the fact that I have no idea which way is up.

And as for Tohsaka—my senior as a mage, or rather, the one of us who's actually a legitimate Master——
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Phew.”
I take a deep breath and look over the yard.
I’ve heard what I needed to hear, but the fact that I still don’t know anything doesn’t change.
My Senpai as a magus, and an official Master, Tohsaka is…

「ね、余ってるクッションとかない？ あとビーカーと分度器」
こんな感じで、うちの家具の物色に余念がない。

“Hey, do you have any spare cushions? Oh, and a beaker and a protractor?”

She is busily combing through my house for anything she can use.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hey, do you have an extra cushion? And a beaker and a protractor?”
…Is intently searching my house for things.

pages.ja:
「……クッションならとなりの客間のを持ってけ。
けどビーカーと分度器なんて、普通の家には置いてない」
「はあ？ 信じられない、魔術師なら実験用具ぐらい置いておくものよ？」
文句だけ言って、忙しそうに別棟に戻っていく。

pages.en:
“…Take the cushions from the guest room next door.

“But normal houses don't have beakers and protractors lying around.”

“What? I don't believe this. A mage should at least keep basic laboratory equipment on hand.”

With that complaint and nothing else, she hurries back to the other wing.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…You can take the cushion in the next room.
But a normal household doesn’t have beakers nor protractors.”
“Huh? I can’t believe it. A magus should always keep experimental tools around.”
Leaving that complaint, she goes back to the outbuilding busily.

遠坂がうちに泊まる、というのはもう確定らしい。
さっき別棟の客室に行ったら、一番いい部屋に
“ただいま改装中につき、立ち入り禁止”
なんてふざけた札がかかっていたし。

“…She really is serious about this.”

Apparently, Tohsaka staying at my house is a settled fact.

When I checked the guest rooms in the other wing earlier, the best one already had an absurd sign hanging on it:

> UNDER RENOVATION—KEEP OUT

I guess it has already been decided that Tohsaka is going to stay at my place.

Saber alone makes me nervous enough. If Tohsaka were nearby all the time too, there wouldn't be anywhere in the house I could relax.

“…Yeah. The outbuilding’s pretty far away, so there’s no problem.”
Just having Saber around causes some tension, so if Tohsaka was near me too, I wouldn’t get any peace.

「ああ、もうどうにでも
」

pages.en:
“——Hah.”

I take what must be my umpteenth deep breath today and stare blankly up at the sky.

Maybe it's the exhaustion, but lying here brings sleep over me almost at once.

“Ah, whatever——”

*Whatever happens, happens.* I close my eyes in a burst of reckless resignation.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Phew.”
I sigh once again and stare up at the sky.
Maybe I’m tired, but doing all this makes me sleepy.
“Man, just”
…Do what you like. Becoming desperate, I close my eyes.

目を閉じた途端、あっさりと眠りに落ちた。

pages.en:
…Maybe that parting shot did the trick.

The instant I close my eyes, I drop effortlessly into sleep.

…Maybe that comment helped.

By the time I come to, the sun has set, and Saber, Tohsaka, and I are gathered in the living room.

I woke up only moments ago.

Saber appeared in the living room at some point without my noticing.

And Tohsaka has apparently just finished renovating her room.

The three of us have gathered in the living room, but sitting here in silence doing nothing cannot be good for anyone's sanity.

Honestly, she has done remarkably well as she pleased for her first day here.

Geez, it seems she’s really selfish from her first day here.
